mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital toward equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a contraction in the housing sector, which reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate profits and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates robust manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 5.0% annually signals persistent inflation that forces the central bank to maintain high interest rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with high inflation
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during monetary tightening cycles when CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0% annually, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.
